# The felt of holes 4-6, generated by make_course.py from course.py (do not edit).
new
material new Felt --base-color 0.1686 0.8588 0.4471 --no-slot
material new Stripe --base-color 0.6549 0.9608 0.2784 --no-slot
material new Tee --base-color 1.0000 0.6706 0.4824 --no-slot
# hole 4: SLIDING GATES
add mesh grid --name Green4 --size 1 --x-subdivisions 98 --y-subdivisions 28 --location 0 0 0
scale 9.8000 2.8000 1
apply --scale
translate 12.0000 -0.0000 0
apply --location
material assign Felt
attribute set position "vec(pos.x, pos.y, 0.12 + 0.06 * 1 * clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (1.4)) / (-2.8), 0, 1) + -0.03 * pow(2.718282, 0 - ((pos.x - (8.6)) * (pos.x - (8.6)) + ((0 - pos.y) - (0.2)) * ((0 - pos.y) - (0.2))) / 0.2450))"
mode edit
select face where "!((pos.x > 7.100 && pos.x < 16.900 && (0 - pos.y) > -1.400 && (0 - pos.y) < 1.400)) || ((pos.x - 8.6) * (pos.x - 8.6) + ((0 - pos.y) - 0.2) * ((0 - pos.y) - 0.2) < 0.0529)"
delete only-faces
select face where "(floor((pos.x + 100) / 0.7) % 2) == 0"
material assign Stripe
select face where "abs(pos.x - 16.1) < 0.4 && abs((0 - pos.y) - 0.0) < 0.4"
material assign Tee
mode object
shade flat
# hole 5: CLOUD GAP
add mesh grid --name Green5 --size 1 --x-subdivisions 98 --y-subdivisions 26 --location 0 0 0
scale 9.8000 2.6000 1
apply --scale
translate 0.0000 -0.0000 0
apply --location
material assign Felt
attribute set position "vec(pos.x, pos.y, 0.12 + 0.42 * (((pos.x - (1.6)) / (-1.2000000000000002)) * (((pos.x - (1.6)) / (-1.2000000000000002)) >= 0) * (((pos.x - (1.6)) / (-1.2000000000000002)) <= 1.0001)) * 1 + -0.03 * pow(2.718282, 0 - ((pos.x - (-3.4)) * (pos.x - (-3.4)) + ((0 - pos.y) - (-0.2)) * ((0 - pos.y) - (-0.2))) / 0.2450))"
mode edit
select face where "!((pos.x > -4.900 && pos.x < -1.000 && (0 - pos.y) > -1.300 && (0 - pos.y) < 1.300) || (pos.x > 0.400 && pos.x < 4.900 && (0 - pos.y) > -1.300 && (0 - pos.y) < 1.300)) || (pos.x > -1.000 && pos.x < 0.400 && (0 - pos.y) > -1.300 && (0 - pos.y) < 1.300) || ((pos.x - -3.4) * (pos.x - -3.4) + ((0 - pos.y) - -0.2) * ((0 - pos.y) - -0.2) < 0.0529)"
delete only-faces
select face where "(floor((pos.x + 100) / 0.7) % 2) == 0"
material assign Stripe
select face where "abs(pos.x - 4.1) < 0.4 && abs((0 - pos.y) - 0.0) < 0.4"
material assign Tee
mode object
shade flat
# hole 6: STEP UP
add mesh grid --name Green6 --size 1 --x-subdivisions 98 --y-subdivisions 60 --location 0 0 0
scale 9.8000 6.0000 1
apply --scale
translate -12.0000 -0.0000 0
apply --location
material assign Felt
attribute set position "vec(pos.x, pos.y, 0.12 + 0.5 * 1 * (clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (0.6)) / (-1.2), 0, 1) * clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (0.6)) / (-1.2), 0, 1) * (3 - 2 * clamp(((0 - pos.y) - (0.6)) / (-1.2), 0, 1))) + -0.04 * pow(2.718282, 0 - ((pos.x - (-15.2)) * (pos.x - (-15.2)) + ((0 - pos.y) - (-1.9)) * ((0 - pos.y) - (-1.9))) / 0.3200))"
mode edit
select face where "!((pos.x > -16.900 && pos.x < -7.100 && (0 - pos.y) > -3.000 && (0 - pos.y) < 3.000)) || ((pos.x - -15.2) * (pos.x - -15.2) + ((0 - pos.y) - -1.9) * ((0 - pos.y) - -1.9) < 0.0529)"
delete only-faces
select face where "(floor((pos.x + 100) / 0.7) % 2) == 0"
material assign Stripe
select face where "abs(pos.x - -8.1) < 0.4 && abs((0 - pos.y) - 2.2) < 0.4"
material assign Tee
mode object
shade flat
export greens2.glb
